$comment: §4, §7, §48, §49. Which gate applies is a FUNCTION of what is retained, never a label the caller chooses.

SOURCE_COLLECTION.governs: retrieval whose material may become normalized source content and feed RawRecord, NormalizedRecord, Signal, Claim and Evidence

PUBLIC_HTTP_OBSERVATION.governs: one governed request against a publicly accessible HTTP target under a frozen measurement contract, retaining a transport-level outcome

precedence_rule.$comment: §7. Deterministic, and not selectable by the caller.
precedence_rule.rule: the track is determined by the DECLARED RETENTION PROFILE, not by the caller's stated intent. If the profile retains a response body, publisher expressive content, or any material whose value to us is what the publisher wrote, SOURCE_COLLECTION_GOVERNANCE_APPLIES.
precedence_rule.why: the stricter rights question must win, and a classification a caller can pick is a classification that will be picked to suit.

how_it_is_enforced: the retention policy's persisted classes are an allowlist that contains no body class, so a body-retaining configuration is not expressible in the observation track's own contract rather than being forbidden by a note beside it
